title: Kiñit Classification in Ethiopian Chants, Azmaris and Modern Music: A New Dataset and CNN Benchmark
reasoning: The paper creates a dataset (EMIR) and benchmarks models for classifying Ethiopian music. A significant portion of this dataset is composed of 'Orthodox Tewahedo chants', which are a form of religious music from the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church. The task involves classifying musical categories that include these religious chants, thus constituting a benchmark of a component of a specific faith tradition.
